description: This file contains CSS styles defining variables for colors, backgrounds, borders, and text, as well as utility classes for buttons and input fields, to be used in a web application's user interface.

classes.name: btn
classes.description: Utility class for buttons with styles for background color, text color, border radius, and hover effects.

classes.name: card
classes.description: Utility class for card-like components with background, border, and shadow styles.

classes.name: surface
classes.description: Utility class for similar to card class, providing a subtle surface effect with background and border styles.
